name: isocan
description: An isomorphic canvas: one 2.5D surface, driven from a web app and a terminal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @isocan/server" "npm run dev -w @isocan/web"

//: Root dependencies are what the root's own files import — index.mjs and rc.mjs (tsx), scripts/ (ws, the MCP SDK, unified, remark-parse, css-tree, parse5), test/setup.ts (undici) — plus @types/node, the one dependency the release manifest declares (RELEASE_DEPENDENCIES in scripts/release.mjs), and @types/css-tree, which stays because dropping it makes it dev-only and `npm prune --omit=dev` would take it out of the home image. The copy of the CLI's runtime deps that used to live here served git installs from main, which install an empty directory (#47); installs come from `#release`, whose bundled CLI declares none of them (cleanup phase 4, DC-2; test/packaging.test.ts holds the rule). The workspaces themselves are deliberately NOT dependencies — bin/workspace-loader.mjs resolves them by path, because link dependencies break every reinstall. `workspaces` and `prepare` are why installs come from the release branch and not from here (#47, scripts/release.mjs).
